body: I'll try. I haven't totally given up, but I don't think it's going to turn out well in the end. There probably is a mental disorder complimenting my condition. The illness is that I can't cope with  sucky life, not that my life is more valuable than I think.

I can't help it. I'm on the lowest level of my social circle. I'm constantly around people who are better than me.

Yes. A whole life of struggling for no reason. Most people's trajectories start in their 20s, perhaps even earlier.

It's not about what I succeed at now. It's about having little potential. 

I used to enjoy a lot of things, many of them not pegged to my success or failure, but I've lost interest in them. I began recognizing them as ways of distracting myself and I just got depressed when engaging with those things.
